title: Great app with beautiful and easy to use UI
body:
i'm loving this app a lot, it has a very great UI and is overall beautiful 
i have a few suggestions that i would love to hear your thoughts on, and if maybe one day such suggestions could be added to the app, here i go:
1/ sub-lists: imagine having a group of lists, and inside a specific list you could make an extra "sub-list", i personally would love such an extra little addition and it would help me out a lot in terms of organizing all sorts of lists etc
2/ maybe a simple drawing addition? 
3/ personalized wallpapers for lists, just add from your phone directly or from the internet 
4/ a circle that you can "check" just like in the Notes app
5/ a dark mode! 

that is all! thank you!
author: Shiro X
